manifest.name: dsh-fullscreen-input
manifest.description: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板：在整屏空间里写多行文本，可拖动标题栏移动、可拖边框改大小，引用与附件都与主输入框共用同一份草稿。Enter 换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法下 Shift+Enter 也不会被误判成发送。
manifest.author: AL_Yichen <alyichen0815@gmail.com>

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js && node --check src/client.js

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-fullscreen-input.
#
# This is what makes the package a PROFILE LAYER rather than an inert dependency:
# the row below mounts the plugin, and the package's `dsh.client` block
# (package.json) is what gets the browser half served and loaded. A package that
# declares only `dsh.client` is not installable.
#
# The row id `fullscreen-input` is what a profile-level patch targets to disable
# the plugin.
- insert:
    - id: fullscreen-input
      name: dsh-fullscreen-input

readme.text:
[](README.en.md) [](README.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fullscreen-input) [](./LICENSE) [](#兼容性) [](https://github.com/AL-Yichen/dsh-fullscreen-input/pulls)

给 DSH 的输入框加一个**全屏输入面板**：点开它，在整屏空间里写多行文本，写完点按钮发送。`Enter` 只换行、只有 `Ctrl+Enter` 才发送；面板可以移动、可以拖边框改大小，引用与附件都与主输入框共用同一份草稿。

readme.section: 为什么需要一个全屏输入框
readme.text:
DSH 自带的输入框只有**窄窄一条**：写长提示词时只能在一个很扁的区域里翻来覆去，引用、附件、正文全挤在一起，想通读一遍自己写了什么几乎做不到。

这个面板把输入区**放大到整屏**：一次能看到的文本量是原来的十几倍；写完之后还能拖标题栏把它挪到别处、拖边框改成想要的宽高，把背后的会话露出来对照着看。**它不是只读预览，而是替换掉那条窄输入框的编辑场所**——草稿是同一份，在面板里改完关掉，主输入框里就是新内容。

*深色主题。面板背后那份草稿就是主输入框里的同一份——面板里写得开，主输入框里会因高度受限被截断。*

DSH 原有输入框的 `Shift+Enter` 换行判定依赖一个很短的宽容窗口——输入法组合结束后的 **10 毫秒**内仍算「正在组合」。中文输入法频繁使用 Shift / Enter（切换中英、确认候选词），很容易落进这个窗口，于是 `Shift+Enter` 被误判成发送，多行文本根本写不舒服。

**面板里没有「Enter 发送」这条路径**，所以这个问题在这里不存在。但它是**顺带**解决的：即使没有这个毛病，一个全屏的输入场所本身也是需要的。

打开 DSH 侧栏的 **「插件」** 页面，点 **添加插件**，在输入框里填入包名 `dsh-fullscreen-input`，然后点安装。

> 那个输入框也接受 Git 地址、压缩包或本地绝对路径——所以没有发布到 npm 的插件同样能从这里装。插件管理页只管理声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的包，本插件已声明。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fullscreen-input
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，刷新页面。

```sh
git clone <本仓库> dsh-fullscreen-input
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<克隆下来的绝对路径>
```

Windows 例：`link:D:/example/dsh-fullscreen-input`

因为是 `link:` 安装，改完源码跑一次 `node build-client.mjs` 重建，**刷新页面即生效**，不用重装。
输入框下方工具栏（「+」按钮所在那一行）会多出一个图标，悬停显示「全屏输入」。点开就是面板；默认 `F2` 也能唤起它。

| 按键 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | 换行 |
| `Shift+Enter` | 换行（与 `Enter` 等价，Shift 在面板里只表示换行） |
| `Ctrl+Enter` / `Cmd+Enter` | 发送 |
| `Esc` | 关闭面板（设置窗口开着时先关设置窗口，面板保留） |
| `Ctrl+0` | 把面板恢复到默认位置与默认大小（等同双击标题栏）。**面板不可达时的自救入口**：不要求焦点在面板内，只要面板开着就生效 |
| `F2` | 打开 / 关闭面板（可在设置里改绑为其它功能键） |
| 中文输入法组词中的 `Enter` / `Ctrl+Enter` | 换行，**绝不发送** |
| 点击面板之外的区域 | 关闭面板（等同 `Esc`；关掉遮罩后不适用） |

**关闭面板不会丢内容。** 面板与主输入框读写的是**同一份草稿**——不是两份内容互相同步，而是同一个值。所以在面板里敲的字、在主输入框里敲的字，都是同一份。

| 能力 | 怎么用 |
|---|---|
| **写多行** | 整个面板就是输入区：`Enter` 换行、`Ctrl+Enter` 发送 |
| **调整大小** | 拖拽边框或四个角（8 个方向；光标会变成对应的缩放箭头，没有额外的可见把手）。最小 360×240、最大不超过视口。**尺寸会被记住**，双击标题可连同位置一起复原 |
| **移动面板** | 按住标题那一行拖动（自由拖动，不设边界）；**双击标题回到居中**。位置默认不记住 |
| **看引用** | 草稿里的 `@` 引用显示为带图标的条目，悬停看完整路径 |
| **移除引用** | 引用条目右上角的「×」。它删掉的是**草稿里那段文字**——引用不是附件，所以在文本框里直接选中删除也一样。点「×」后输入框会失焦（焦点被按钮拿走），点回文本框即可继续输入 |
| **看附件** | 图片显示为缩略图，**点击看大图**；文件显示类型图标与文件名 |
| **移除图片附件** | 鼠标移到缩略图上，右上角出现「×」 |
| **添加文件** | 面板左下角「+」，走 DSH 自己的文件选择器 |
| **粘贴** | 在面板里直接 `Ctrl+V`，图片与文件都能贴进来 |
| **拖放** | 把文件直接拖到面板上 |
| **滚动背景** | 鼠标在**面板之外**滚动滚轮，会滚动背后的会话——边看 LLM 输出边写提示词时不用来回开关面板。面板内部的滚轮仍归面板 |
| **唤起快捷键** | 默认 `F2`，按一下开、再按一下关。可在设置里改成任意功能键（F1–F12）；`Esc` 始终关闭 |
| **面板底色** | 想要不透明的面板就开「纯色面板」，想要磨砂质感就开「启用毛玻璃效果」（两者互斥）；两个都关则面板完全透明 |
| **关闭遮罩** | 设置里的「启用遮罩层」可整个关掉遮罩：鼠标从此能直接点击、滚动背后页面。代价是「点击面板外关闭」消失，请用 `Esc` 或唤起快捷键 |
| **使用提示** | 首次打开面板时会弹一次提示。可勾选「不再提示」；设置最下方有「查看提示」可随时唤回 |

面板头部的**小太阳图标**按钮（八齿造型，看起来更像太阳而不是齿轮）→「全屏输入设置」：

**遮罩层**
- **启用遮罩层**（默认开）
- **遮罩层不透明度**：默认完全透明（0%）
- **遮罩层雾化**：默认不雾化（0%）

**面板底色**
- **启用毛玻璃效果**：默认关闭
- **纯色面板**：默认关闭，与毛玻璃**互斥**——只铺底色、不加模糊；开启时会把「面板不透明度」推到 100%，直接得到一个不透明的纯色面板
- **面板雾化**（默认 40%）、**面板不透明度**（默认 25%）、**面板颜色**：「跟随主题」、6 个固定色，最后那个格子是**系统颜色选择器**——点它选任意颜色
- 底色共三种状态：**两个开关都关 = 面板完全透明**；只开「纯色面板」= 铺色但不模糊；只开「启用毛玻璃效果」= 铺色 + 模糊

**面板行为**
- **记住面板大小**（默认开）、**记住面板位置**（默认关）：两者独立，都关掉时每次打开都回到默认大小与居中
- **唤起快捷键**（默认 `F2`）：点一下按钮，再按一个功能键即可改绑
- **使用提示**：点「查看提示」再次显示首次使用的提示弹窗

设置会持久保存，刷新与重开都保留。

面板与宿主 composer 是**两套输入面**，下面几条是由此而来的、刻意的边界：

- **面板里没有 `@` 引用菜单。** 宿主的 `@` 菜单绑在它自己的富文本 composer 上（在光标处弹出候选），而面板用的是普通 `textarea`——宿主不知道那里有光标，所以敲 `@` 不会弹菜单。**要加引用请用面板左下角的「+」、直接粘贴文件、或从系统拖放**：三条路都会把文件变成引用，与在 composer 里选出来的是同一种，只是引用会落在光标处（粘贴文件时落在末尾）。
- **「遮罩层雾化」作用于整个视口**（含面板背后），因为遮罩本身是全屏的。这是当前实现的行为，不是故障。
- **面板里没有上传进度与重试。** 附件上传走的是宿主自己的路径，面板只负责触发；要接管进度就得替换宿主自己的附件栏，代价大于收益，已明确不做。
- **面板不做焦点陷阱。** 它只处理自己内部的 `Enter` 与 `Escape`，不接管全局按键。

- **DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`**（即 0.2.x 发行线）。面板深度依赖宿主的槽位 props、`inputActions` 与 `insertReference` 的 revision-CAS 语义，这些正是次要版本最可能变动的地方，所以上界是刻意收窄的——旧版声明的 `≥ 0.2.0-rc.1` 会无声地宣称兼容未来的 `0.3.0+`。
- **Node ≥ 20**（仅构建源码时需要）
- 纯浏览器侧插件：host 侧是空实现，**不产生任何网络请求**，不读写会话数据

本插件**不需要**任何权限档位、审批放宽或沙箱调整即可工作。它请求的能力面刻意保持在最小：

| 能力 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `ctx.effect` | 注册样式表与 locale 字典的清理（卸载时完整回滚，无残留） |
| `ctx.inject(['slots','locale','sessions','conversation'])` | 等待并取得这四个服务；全部是读取或驱动宿主自己的输入动作 |
| `slots.inject` + `slots.register` | 往 `conversation.input.left` 槽位贡献一个工具栏按钮 |

**未使用**：`ctx.fs`、`ctx.network`、`ctx.shell`、`ctx.resources`。它不注册任何 Agent 工具，因此不会扩展模型的工具面。
唯一的本机持久化是一个 `localStorage` 键（面板外观偏好）；唯一接触文件的路径是驱动宿主**自己的**隐藏文件输入框，且请求文件对话框必须在你的点击或粘贴手势内完成。完整的攻击面说明与漏洞报告方式见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。

```sh
node build-client.mjs      # 把 src/client.js 包成 lib/client.js
npm run check              # 语法检查（三个文件）
```

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `src/client.js` | 唯一手写实现（浏览器侧，全部 UI 与逻辑） |
| `lib/client.js` | **构建产物，运行时实际加载的就是这个** |
| `lib/index.js` | host 侧，空实现 |
| `build-client.mjs` | 构建脚本，纯文本包裹，无任何依赖 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，挂载 row id `fullscreen-input` |

**改完 `src/` 一定要重建**，否则刷新页面看到的还是旧代码。

[](README.en.md) [](README.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fullscreen-input) [](./LICENSE) [](https://github.com/AL-Yichen/dsh-fullscreen-input#compatibility) [](https://github.com/AL-Yichen/dsh-fullscreen-input/pulls)

A **full-screen input panel** for the DSH composer: open it, write multi-line text across the whole screen, then click to send. `Enter` only ever inserts a newline and only `Ctrl+Enter` sends; the panel can be moved and resized by dragging its border, and its references and attachments are the same draft the composer holds.

The composer DSH ships is **one narrow strip**: writing a long prompt means shuffling around inside a very short area with references, attachments and prose all crammed together, and reading back what you wrote is close to impossible.

This panel **blows the input area up to the whole screen** — you see an order of magnitude more of your text at once — and once you are done you can drag its title bar out of the way or drag a border to the shape you want, so the conversation behind it is visible for reference. **It is not a read-only preview; it replaces that strip as the place you edit in.** The draft is one value, so whatever you change in the panel is what the composer holds when you close it.
*Dark theme. The draft behind the panel is the same one the composer holds — it fits here and gets clipped there.*

readme.section: The problem it solves along the way
readme.text: DSH's own composer decides whether `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline or sends by looking at a very short grace window — a keydown within **10 ms** of a composition ending still counts as "composing". A Chinese IME uses Shift and Enter constantly (to switch languages and to confirm candidates), so `Shift+Enter` lands inside that window easily and gets read as "send".

readme.section: The problem it solves along the way
readme.text: **There is no "Enter sends" path in the panel at all**, so that problem does not exist here. But it is solved **along the way**: a full-screen place to write is worth having even without that particular fault.

Open the **Plugins** page in DSH's sidebar, click **Add plugin**, type the package name `dsh-fullscreen-input`, and install.

> That box also accepts a Git URL, an archive, or a local absolute path, so a plugin that was never published to npm installs the same way. The plugin manager only manages packages that declare `dsh.bundle`; this one does.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-fullscreen-input
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the page afterwards.

```sh
git clone <this repository> dsh-fullscreen-input
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to the clone>
```

Windows example: `link:D:/example/dsh-fullscreen-input`

Because it is a `link:` install, rebuild once after editing the source with `node build-client.mjs` and **refresh the page** — no reinstall needed.
A new icon appears in the composer's tool row (the line with the "+" button); hovering it says "Full-screen input". Clicking it opens the panel, and `F2` summons it too.

| Key | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | newline |
| `Shift+Enter` | newline (same as `Enter`; Shift only ever means newline here) |
| `Ctrl+Enter` / `Cmd+Enter` | send |
| `Esc` | close the panel (if a settings dialog is open, that closes first and the panel stays) |
| `Ctrl+0` | restore the panel's default position and size (same as double-clicking the header). **The way back in when the header is out of reach**: it does not need focus inside the panel, only the panel to be open |
| `F2` | open / close the panel (rebindable to another function key in settings) |
| `Enter` / `Ctrl+Enter` while an IME is composing | newline — **never** sends |
| Click outside the panel | close the panel (same as `Esc`; does not apply once the mask is switched off) |

**Closing the panel loses nothing.** The panel and the composer read and write **one draft** — not two copies kept in sync, but the same value. So text typed in the panel and text typed in the composer are the same text.

| Capability | How |
|---|---|
| **Write multi-line** | the whole panel is the input area: `Enter` for a newline, `Ctrl+Enter` to send |
| **Resize** | drag any border or corner (eight directions; the cursor changes to the matching resize arrow, and there are no visible grips). Minimum 360×240, never larger than the viewport. **The size is remembered**; double-clicking the title restores size and position together |
| **Move it** | drag the title row (free movement, no bounds); **double-click the title to recentre**. Position is not remembered by default |
| **See references** | `@` references in the draft appear as labelled entries; hover for the full path |
| **Remove a reference** | the "×" at the top right of the entry. It deletes **the matching text from the draft** — a reference is not an attachment, so selecting that text in the textarea and deleting it does exactly the same thing. Clicking "×" takes focus away from the textarea (the button took it); click back into the textarea to keep typing |
| **See attachments** | images show as thumbnails — **click to enlarge**; files show a type icon and name |
| **Remove an image** | hover the thumbnail; an "×" appears in the corner

The **sun icon** in the panel header (an eight-toothed shape, which reads as a sun rather than a gear at this size) opens "Full-screen input settings":

**Mask**
- **Enable mask** (on by default)
- **Mask opacity**: fully transparent by default (0%)
- **Mask fog**: no fog by default (0%)

**Pane background**
- **Frosted glass**: off by default
- **Solid pane**: off by default, and **mutually exclusive** with frosted glass — it lays down colour without blur. Turning it on pushes "panel opacity" to 100%, so you get an opaque pane straight away
- **Pane fog** (default 40%), **panel opacity** (default 25%), **panel colour**: "follow theme", six fixed colours, and a **system colour picker** in the last cell — click it to pick anything
- The background therefore has three states: **both switches off = fully transparent**; solid only = colour without blur; frosted only = colour plus blur

**Panel behaviour**
- **Remember panel size** (on by default) and **remember panel position** (off by default): independent, and with both off every open returns to the default size and centre
- **Summon hotkey** (`F2` by default): click the button, then press a function key to rebind
- **Intro dialog**: "show tips" displays the first-run dialog again

Settings persist across refreshes and restarts.
The panel and the host composer are **two separate input surfaces**, and these limits follow from that:

- **There is no `@` reference menu inside the panel.** The host's `@` menu is bound to its own rich-text composer and opens at the caret there; the panel is a plain `textarea`, so the host has no caret to track and the menu never opens. **To add a reference, use the panel's `+` button, paste a file, or drop one from the system** — all three turn the file into a reference of the same kind the composer produces, only placed at the caret (or at the end when pasting files).
- **Mask fog blurs the entire viewport** (including what is directly behind the pane), because the mask itself covers the viewport. That is how the current implementation behaves — not a fault.
- **No upload progress or retry inside the panel.** Uploads go through the host's own path and the panel only triggers them; taking over progress would mean replacing the host's attachment bar, which is more cost than it is worth.
- **No focus trap.** The panel handles `Enter` and `Escape` inside itself and does not claim global keys.

- **DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`** (the 0.2.x release line). The panel leans on host internals — slot props, `inputActions`, and the revision-CAS semantics of `insertReference` — which are exactly what a minor bump moves, so the upper bound is deliberately tight. The previous `>= 0.2.0-rc.1` silently claimed compatibility with every future `0.3.0+`.
- **Node >= 20** (only needed to build from source)
- Browser-side only: the host half is an empty implementation, it makes **no network requests**, and it does not read or write session data
This plugin needs **no** permission preset, approval relaxation, or sandbox change to work. Its capability surface is deliberately minimal:

| Capability | Why |
|---|---|
| `ctx.effect` | registers cleanup for the stylesheet and the locale dictionaries (fully rolled back on unload, nothing left behind) |
| `ctx.inject(['slots','locale','sessions','conversation'])` | waits for and obtains those four services; every use is either a read or a drive of the host's own input actions |
| `slots.inject` + `slots.register` | contributes one toolbar button into the `conversation.input.left` slot |

**Not used**: `ctx.fs`, `ctx.network`, `ctx.shell`, `ctx.resources`. It registers no agent tools, so it does not widen the model's tool surface.

Its only local persistence is one `localStorage` key (panel appearance preferences). Its only path to a file is driving the host's **own** hidden file input, and asking for a file dialog has to happen inside your click or paste gesture. See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for the full surface and how to report a problem.

```sh
node build-client.mjs      # wraps src/client.js into lib/client.js
npm run check              # syntax check (three files)
```

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/client.js` | the only hand-written implementation (browser side: all UI and logic) |
| `lib/client.js` | **the build artifact — this is what actually loads at runtime** |
| `lib/index.js` | host side, an empty implementation |
| `build-client.mjs` | build script: plain text wrapping, no dependencies |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch, mounting row id `fullscreen-input` |
**Always rebuild after editing `src/`**, or a page refresh will still run the old code.
